title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash
description: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline. We’ve also lowered Clef-flash pricing and boosted Clef inference speeds by up to 2.0x.

title: Why Brand Protection Must Extend Across Social Media, Marketplaces and Domains
description: Brand impersonation across social media, marketplaces and lookalike domains creates interconnected cybersecurity risks. Coordinated monitoring, AI-assisted detection, human validation and enforcement can help organizations identify fraudulent campaigns and protect customers.

title: SpaceX Agrees to Acquire Nationwide 800 MHz Spectrum for Starlink Mobile
description: SpaceX has agreed to acquire nationwide 800 MHz spectrum licenses from Grain Management in a deal reportedly worth $8 billion, potentially expanding Starlink Mobile's ability to integrate satellite and terrestrial connectivity.

title: Introducing on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects
description: On-demand CPU and memory profiling for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects is now available. Now you can generate interactive flamegraphs directly in production to quickly track down memory leaks and performance bottlenecks.

title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.

title: It’s Cybersecurity Awareness Month: When Did You Last Change Your Password?
description: October is Cybersecurity Awareness Month. ARIN Chief Information Security Officer Christian Johnson shares a quick reminder about the value of taking a few minutes to do some basic account housekeeping every now and then.

title: Rolling the root key
description: The root key of the DNS is scheduled to roll on 11 October. How many DNSSEC-validating recursive resolvers have learned of KSK-2024 and incorporated it into their TA sets?

title: US Seizes Seven Domains Linked to Alleged Chinese Cyber Espionage Operation
description: US authorities seized seven domains supporting alleged Chinese cyber espionage tools used against critical infrastructure and other networks across three continents, disrupting scanning and phishing services while leaving questions about their recovery.

title: The TLD Fight Is On: 1,615 Applications, and One Question Nobody Is Asking
description: ICANN's 2026 new gTLD round attracted 1,615 applications, with competition concentrated on contested extensions. Strong registration growth contrasts with weak renewal rates, raising questions about long-term demand and commercial viability.

title: UK and Germany Agree to Coordinate Cyber Defense Against Infrastructure Sabotage
description: The UK and Germany have announced a partnership to counter cyberattacks and infrastructure sabotage through intelligence sharing and coordinated responses, but have yet to specify participating agencies, covered sectors or operational mechanisms.

title: DNS Hijacks Across Three ccTLDs Linked to 32 Unauthorized HTTPS Certificates
description: An examination of certificate transparency logs identified 32 unauthorized HTTPS certificates following DNS hijacks affecting Ghana, Sierra Leone and American Samoa, exposing vulnerabilities in domain validation and the infrastructure supporting trusted web connections.

title: From Apps to Agents: How the 2026 New gTLD Strings Mirror a Changed Internet
description: ICANN's 2026 new gTLD applications reveal a shift toward AI agents, developer infrastructure and digital trust, with .agent replacing .app as the most contested string amid growing competition and persistent geographic disparities.

title: AI Is Raising the Stakes for Language Inclusion on the Internet
description: Research from the Coalition on Digital Impact reveals persistent barriers to online participation in native languages, raising concerns that AI could deepen linguistic inequalities unless language support becomes a foundational requirement of digital infrastructure.

title: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign
description: We redesigned Cloudflare Radar to make real-time global traffic and outage data accessible to a wider audience — including journalists, less technical researchers, and everyday users. By introducing an interactive map and standardized components, we simplified navigation while pr…

title: EC Chair’s update: APNIC 62 and Member Meeting
description: The APNIC 62 AMM brought Members and the community together to discuss APNIC's financial sustainability, governance, and future direction.

title: Big Brands, Bold Moves: The 2026 dotBrand Wave
description: ICANN's 2026 new gTLD round attracted 333 dotBrand applications, representing 20.6% of submissions. Participation across major industries reflects growing interest in controlling branded namespaces and strengthening enterprise digital identity.

title: ‘Magnifica Humanitas’ and the human future of Artificial Intelligence
description: The ‘Magnifica Humanitas’ explores how technological power affects dignity, justice, and social responsibility, and calls for both regulation and deeper public engagement in shaping the future.

title: Who Checks the Models? The Case for UN Oversight of Frontier AI
description: As AI agents demonstrate increasingly autonomous behavior, Gabriel Accascina proposes a UN-led evaluation system modeled on WHO prequalification, using independent testing and government procurement incentives to strengthen international oversight of frontier AI.

title: Building an evidence-grounded agentic security operations harness on Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Managed Defense uses a team of specialized AI agents built on Workers and global network telemetry to analyze security alerts. By separating deterministic evidence collection from model inference, the system delivers grounded recommendations to Managed Defense Analysts…

title: Get to Know the Draft Policies Up for Discussion at ARIN 58
description: Prepare for the upcoming meeting with this look at the Draft Policies on the agenda at ARIN 58, taking place 22-23 October in Miami, Florida, and online.

title: PeeringDB product update: April to September 2026
description: Guest Post: PeeringDB has expanded Advanced Search with API query generation and interactive facility maps, making it easier to move between manual research and automation. The latest update also introduces data quality improvements, operational enhancements, and plans for a new …

title: The keys to the Internet change on October 11. Are you ready?
description: On October 11, 2026, the DNS root switches to a new key-signing key (KSK-2024). Learn what this means for you, and how RFC 8509 trust anchor sentinels allow you to test whether your DNS resolver is ready for the rollover.

title: How to Propose and Read Draft Policy at ARIN
description: Anyone can help shape the policies that govern Internet number resources in the ARIN region. Here’s how to submit a policy proposal, read a Draft Policy page, and make your voice heard at our next Public Policy and Members Meeting.

title: Everything we launched during Birthday Week 2026
description: We celebrated our 16th birthday with 46 announcements across open source, post-quantum security, AI agents, and developer platform upgrades. Here’s a day-by-day roundup of everything we shipped.

title: One year later: the power of 1.1.1.1 interns
description: A year after announcing our goal to hire 1,111 interns, more than 750 early-career builders have shipped real products across 48 teams at Cloudflare. From Birthday Week launches to post-quantum security, our interns prove that AI amplifies human potential instead of replacing it.

title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
description: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.

title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers
description: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.

title: Is RPKI becoming harmful to BGP stability?
description: Guest Post: Could the growing deployment of RPKI become a threat to routing stability? This study analyses more than 11 years of RPKI and BGP data, measuring how much routing activity can be associated with RPKI-related changes.

title: Get Ready for ARIN Elections
description: The 2026 ARIN Elections are approaching, making this a good time to review the process and the participation opportunities available to you and your organization. Here’s a step-by-step guide to help you prepare to cast your vote this fall.

title: [Podcast] The October 2026 root KSK roll
description: In this episode of PING, Verisign's Duane Wessels discusses the transition to the third DNS root KSK key pair, which is scheduled to begin signing the root zone on 11 October 2026.

title: New features for RFC-Editor.org
description: New features implemented on RFC-Editor.org aim to make the site more useful and engaging for RFC consumers.

title: Opinion: The economics of AI
description: As spending on data centres, power, and computing capacity surges, the question is no longer whether AI delivers value, but who will ultimately pay for it.

title: AI-driven networking and infrastructure design at APNIC 62
description: Presenters at APNIC 62 explored how AI is reshaping network design and operations, from next-generation optical architectures to autonomous management systems, highlighting scale challenges and improved reliability, efficiency, and operational decision-making.

title: Restricting the Acquisition of Additional LIR Accounts
description: The RIPE NCC Executive Board has decided to temporarily restrict members' ability to acquire additional Local Internet Registry (LIR) accounts. Taking effect on Tuesday, 29 September, the restriction also covers requests already in progress. The decision is a first step towards a…

description: The days may be shortening as we enter fall at ARIN HQ in Virginia, but we’re not slowing down the steady pace of changes, upgrades, and outreach that cropped up throughout July, August, and September. We’ve gathered the season’s key developments and upcoming opportunities in thi…

title: Thou shall not pass: Gatekeeping outbound TLS connections
description: Guest Post: To quantify how closely guideline recommendations align with real-world TLS deployments, we collected over 50 million TLS handshakes during two weeks from our research institution.

description: We would like to congratulate the organizations receiving funding from the ARIN Community Grant Program this year! Senior Project Manager Amanda Gauldin shares details about their projects.

description: The last six months has seen important improvements to PeeringDB. We've added in page maps for searches of interconnection facilities and improved the data quality for AS-SET names.

description: With RIPE 93 fast approaching, the RIPE Chair Team shares updates on policy and Working Group activity, the Code of Conduct Team document, and recent events across the Internet community.

description: A governance structure is strongest when the responsibilities written down on paper match the responsibilities exercised in practice. This proposal to change the RIPE NCC’s governance structure is intended to make sure that they do.

title: CAPIF 5: Regional Interconnectivity in Central Asia
description: Central Asia’s Internet looks very different than it did back at CAPIF 1. We trace the rise of direct regional routes, stronger routing security and new connectivity options - along with the gaps that remain.

title: IETF email infrastructure transition completed on 11 September
description: A transition to a new modern, modular, and containerized infrastructure for email services provided for ietf.org, iab.org, irtf.org, rfc-editor.org (including email lists) was completed on 11 September 2026.

title: The /3 Body Problem
description: A large chunk of IPv6 is heading for space, and every policy question about it is currently going to be deferred to the RIR communities. This article outlines what those questions look like, and argues why now is the time to start asking them.

title: Survey to gather input on ISE selection criteria
description: The Independent Series Editor (ISE) selection criteria survey is live and we welcome your input on the capabilities and expectations the IAB should consider when selecting a future ISE. Please respond by 11 October 2026.

title: The Internet’s New Edge Builders
description: After building private backbones, content and cloud platforms are now moving closer to users. In doing so, they are taking on delivery roles once associated mainly with independent CDNs.

title: Closing the IPv6 First-Packet Gap with GRAND
description: There is a subtle asymmetry in IPv6 Neighbour Discovery: a host knows how to reach its router before the router necessarily knows how to reach the host. GRAND fixes that asymmetry by making the host proactively advertise its address, and I implemented that mechanism in FreeBSD.

title: Introducing the ARIN 58 Fellows
description: Amanda Gauldin, ARIN Senior Project Manager, shares details about the Fellows, Mentors, and special guests joining us for the ARIN 58 Fellowship Program.

title: When Traceroutes Lie: How TTL Jumps Can Give Us a False Impression of the Internet’s Topology
description: Traceroute is a powerful tool for uncovering how packets travel across the Internet. However, as we recently discovered, some routers tamper with the TTL values in traceroute's probing packets, giving you a false view of how networks are actually interconnected.

description: Internet research can benefit from operational insight, and network operators from research expertise. Building on what we learned at RIPE 92, we look at practical ways to make those connections easier and turn promising conversations into lasting collaboration.

description: Joe Clarke has been appointed as the new IETF Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead and in this post Joe introduces himself and sets out his priorities for the IETF Network.

description: It's time for our annual update on who’s leading the charge for IPv6 adoption in the Caribbean, featuring new leaders and new lessons emerging from this year’s data.

description: Legacy IPv4 Internet number resource holders: Is your registration data still doing its job? Nearly half of ARIN's legacy networks have no validated Point of Contact. Find out why that matters, and how to fix it in minutes.

description: There have been a few changes in IETF Administration LLC staffing since January of this year (2026) including the recent insourcing of the Secretariat, which are summarised here to give an overall view of the staffing structure.
